items.title: Konitz Lee — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: The one called You and Lee with a brass section and Bill Evans, Sonny Dallas, and Roy Haynes that Giuffre also did... The next major record is Motion in sixty-one. You did two days of recording with Sonny Dallas

ctx.x: That one, I confess, I haven’t heard. It looks promising certainly, with the players and the writing.
It was nice. Apparently Sonny Dallas was very uncomfortable with Giuffre. I heard him really criticizing the way Giuffre treated him. Bill Evans was reading the paper between tunes.
